title: Concrete affine etale free-Yoneda generator
statement: For a scheme X in universe u [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], let C be the u-small model of the affine etale site and J its induced topology. Form in AddCommGrpCat.{u+1} the sheafified free Yoneda sheaf with coefficients ULift Z for each c in C, and take the coproduct indexed by C times Unit. Define G_X to be this coproduct transported first to the affine etale site and then to the full etale site by the comparison equivalences. These are actual coproduct, sheafification and equivalence constructions, not arbitrary existence witnesses.
